b3_1_class_definition_by_construction.statement: The B3.1/B3_1_POP_RECORD.md C-A/C-B/C-C class scheme is defined on L_cat_no_bh (dark = C-C iff L_cat_no_bh==0 at a given h). Since the mass_filter_geometry/mass_filter_k flags ONLY feed candidate_hosts_with_bh_mass (darksiren_emri/galaxy_catalogue/handler.py:558-712) and never candidate_hosts_without_bh_mass, L_cat_no_bh cannot differ between arms BY CONSTRUCTION, at any h -- not merely at the 4 tested H4 nodes. R6's bit-identity result (above) is the empirical confirmation of this at the tested nodes.

with_bh_channel_specific_collapse.finding: The entire 621-event with-BH candidate-set collapse under the log-k3 geometry, on this production venue, falls EXCLUSIVELY within the dark class (host_galaxy_index==-1, no known true host). Not one of the 76 in-catalogue (known-true-host) events changes with-BH candidate-set membership. This is the mechanistic explanation for the R1 retention falsifier above: the mirror-fleet-predicted 17-21-point TRUE-HOST retention loss does not materialize on iiib production because the log-k3 window's tightening effect here is confined to impostor/dark-class candidate suppression, not true-host exclusion.
